page.content:
Heliopolitan nine: Atum's line through Osiris and Set.

How Ennead connects

  • Character: Atum — Atum generated the first gods of the Ennead.
  • Topic: Egyptian mythology — The Heliopolitan Ennead is a core divine genealogy of Egyptian myth.
  • Character: Osiris — Osiris is one of the nine of Heliopolis.
  • Character: Isis — Isis is one of the nine of Heliopolis.
  • Character: Set — Set is one of the nine of Heliopolis.
  • Character: Nephthys — Nephthys is one of the nine of Heliopolis.

What is Ennead?

The Ennead of Heliopolis is the nine-god genealogy — Atum (or Ra-Atum), Shu, Tefnut, Geb, Nut, Osiris, Isis, Set, and Nephthys — that frames creation and the kingship quarrel.

Key threads lead to Atum, Egyptian mythology, Osiris, Isis, Set and Nephthys.
